summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Address CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete, Set Default) for Khurpi Microgreens app. All backend API tests passed (10/10). Frontend UI tests verified all operations work correctly through the improved address form.

issues: Address label shows 'Address' instead of the custom name (e.g., 'Test Office') in the card header - the name field is saved but displayed as generic 'Address'

action_items: Consider displaying the address 'name' field (e.g., 'Home', 'Office') in the card header instead of generic 'Address' text
critical_code_review_comments: Address CRUD APIs are well-implemented with proper validation (NOIDA-only delivery)
Form has all required data-testid attributes for testing
Default address logic works correctly - when deleting default, another becomes default
NOIDA validation prevents non-NOIDA addresses from being saved
seed_data_creation: Test addresses with 'TEST_' prefix were created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Address CRUD fully tested. Test user has 1 address remaining (C-101, Tech Park Tower). All data-testid selectors work correctly: address-name-input, address-line1-input, address-line2-input, address-area-input, address-pincode-input, save-address-btn, cancel-address-btn, edit-address-{id}, delete-address-{id}, set-default-{id}

CREATE.details: New address created with all fields (name, address_line_1, address_line_2, area, pincode, city, lat/lng). Toast shows 'Address added successfully'

READ.details: Addresses displayed correctly in list with address details, Default badge, and action buttons (Edit, Delete, Set Default)

UPDATE.details: Edit dialog opens with existing data pre-filled. Changes saved successfully with 'Address updated successfully' toast

SET_DEFAULT.details: Clicking 'Set Default' moves the Default badge to selected address. Toast shows 'Default address updated'

DELETE.details: Browser confirm dialog appears. After confirmation, address removed and toast shows 'Address deleted successfully'. If deleted address was default, another becomes default automatically

VALIDATION.details: Non-NOIDA addresses rejected with error 'We currently deliver only in NOIDA area'. 6-digit pincode validation works

add_address_dialog.map_picker: Location picker with 'Pin on Map' section

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs for address operations - all CRUD operations use real backend endpoints
